description: Adobe Commerce (Magento) ecommerce platform exposing REST, GraphQL and SOAP web APIs.
auth_notes: Third-party integrations use OAuth 1.0a; mobile apps use tokens sent in the Authorization header; admins and customers use login credentials; widgets use sessions.
gate_detail: A merchant admin must create an integration in the Admin and authorize resources; credentials depend on having an Adobe Commerce or Magento instance. Sandbox not stated.
api_scope: Web API framework exposing configured services via REST, GraphQL and SOAP, with resource-level authorization through ACL; also integration-style multi-service calls.
mcp_notes: Sources do not mention an MCP server.
blocker_detail: Credentials are issued by a store administrator via Admin integrations; developers need access to a Commerce instance.

evidence.quote: To prove your identity, specify this token in the Authorization request header on web API calls.
You must register a web service on Admin.
Support for GraphQL , REST (Representational State Transfer) and SOAP (Simple Object Access Protocol).
The system does not currently support webhooks.

uncertainties: Cost and licensing of Adobe Commerce are not stated; Magento Open Source is mentioned but not detailed.
Sandbox availability not established; an API playground is only mentioned.
Cloud Service (SaaS) uses IMS tokens per S3, not detailed.
